messages.subject: Marwick gearmotor failures - need legal help
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Following our call, we'd like Whitfield Carter to act for Ashfield Dynamics on the Marwick Drives problem. To recap: we bought 60 MD-450 gearmotor units from Marwick last March for the Halcyon Linevue conveyor line, and 41 of them have now failed in under nine months. We've had to replace the lot and pay Halcyon downtime damages. It's cost us well over £400k.

Can you send through an engagement letter and tell us what you need from us to get going?

David

David Ashby | Managing Director | Ashfield Dynamics Limited

messages.subject: RE: Marwick gearmotor failures - need legal help
messages.plaintextBody:
David,

Thank you - we'd be glad to act. Our engagement letter is attached; please sign and return the duplicate. Tom Gallagher will have day-to-day conduct, with me supervising.

As a first step we'll send a letter before action to Marwick. To prepare it I'll need your purchase order PO-AD-4471, the order acknowledgement, the delivery notes, your installation and maintenance records, and the Renshaw investigation report. Paul can no doubt help pull those together.

We propose instructing Harriet Stanford of Eldon Chambers if this proceeds.

Kind regards
Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
